punchline: Photo 51 reached Cambridge through routine handoffs, and its owner learned last.
thirty_sec: Photo 51, taken by Raymond Gosling in May 1952, was shown to Watson by Maurice Wilkins on 30 January 1953. In mid-February Max Perutz gave Crick an MRC report with Franklin's calculations. Franklin did not know at the time; how much these mattered is still debated.
question: Whose unfinished work have you shown or forwarded recently without asking, and what would you say to them today?
key_contrast: Routine handoffs versus the owner's own say.
